        ORG     30000

INIT    EQU     25000
PLAY    EQU     25006

        DI
        LD      A,(#5D16)
        RES     4,A
        LD      (DRIVE1+1),A
        SET     4,A
        LD      (DRIVE2+1),A
        CALL    INIT
        LD      HL,#F300
        LD      DE,#F301
        LD      C,L
        LD      B,E
        LD      A,H
        LD      (HL),#F4
        LDIR
        LD      I,A
        IM      2
        LD      HL,BARS
        LD      DE,#F4F4
        LD      BC,END-BARS
        LDIR
        EI
        LD      B,91            ; SECTORS
        LD      HL,0            ; START ADRESS
        PUSH    HL
        LD      DE,(#5CF4)      ; TRK/SEC
        CALL    DISK
        LD      (#5CF4),DE      ; NEW TRK/SEC
        DI
        IM      0
        EI
        CALL    INIT
STOP    JR      STOP


BARS    EX      AF,AF'
        CP      B
Z1      JR      L1
        LD      (Z2+1),A
        EX      AF,AF'
        EI
        JP      #3D2F
L1      EXX
        LD      A,1
        OUT     (254),A
        CALL    PLAY    ; SONG
        SUB     A
        OUT     (254),A
L4      LD      A,0
        EXX
        LD      A,H
        INC     A
        JR      NZ,L3
        LD      A,L
        INC     A
        JR      NZ,L3
        INC     SP
        INC     SP
L3      SUB     A
        LD      (L4+1),A
        EX      AF,AF'
        EI
        JP      #3D2F
DISK    LD      A,#18
        LD      (Z1),A
        LD      A,D
        SRL     A
        CALL    MOPS
        LD      A,#18
        CALL    MIXI
        CALL    MOPS1
FUCK    LD      A,D
        SRL     A
        CALL    MIXI1
        BIT     0,D
DRIVE1  LD      A,#2C
        JR      NZ,DUST
DRIVE2  LD      A,#3C
DUST    CALL    MOPS2
FUCK2   LD      A,E
        INC     A
        CALL    MIXI2
AGAIN   PUSH    HL
        LD      A,#84
        LD      C,1
        CALL    MIXI
        PUSH    BC
        LD      BC,#7F
        LD      A,1
        LD      (Z2+1),A
        LD      A,#28
        LD      (Z1),A
        SUB     A
        EX      AF,AF'
        CALL    MOPS1
        EX      AF,AF'
        PUSH    BC
        LD      A,#18
        LD      (Z1),A
Z2      LD      A,1
        AND     A
        CALL    Z,BARS
        POP     BC
        LD      A,B
        POP     BC
        AND     A
        JR      Z,BACK
TURN    POP     HL
        JR      AGAIN
BACK    CALL    MIXI3
        AND     8
        JR      Z,SHIT
        LD      A,2
        LD      (L4+1),A
        JR      TURN
SHIT    POP     AF
        LD      A,E
        ADD     A,C
        BIT     4,A
        JR      Z,MIXI4
        SUB     A
        LD      E,A
        INC     D
        BIT     0,D
        JR      NZ,BACK2
        LD      A,#58
        CALL    MIXI
        CALL    MOPS1
BACK2   LD      A,B
        SUB     C
        LD      B,A
        RET     Z
        JP      FUCK
MIXI4   INC     E
        DJNZ    FUCK2
        RET
MIXI    PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#2FC3
        EX      (SP),HL
        JP      #3D2F
MIXI3   PUSH    BC,HL
        LD      HL,FIKUS
        PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#3FEC
        PUSH    HL
        LD      C,#1F
        LD      HL,#FFFE
        EI
        JP      #3D2F
FIKUS   DEC     HL
        LD      A,(HL)
        POP     HL,BC
        RET
MIXI1   PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#1E3A
        EX      (SP),HL
        JP      #3D2F
MIXI2   PUSH    BC
        LD      C,#5F
ZIRK    PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,FIKUS2
        PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#2A53
        PUSH    HL
        JP      #3D2F
FIKUS2  POP     HL,BC
        RET
MOPS    PUSH    BC
        LD      C,#7F
        JR      ZIRK
MOPS2   PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#1FF3
        EX      (SP),HL
        JP      #3D2F
MOPS1   PUSH    HL
        LD      HL,#3FE5
        EX      (SP),HL
        JP      #3D2F
END     RET
